description: Grid2Op (Grid To Operate) is a modular Python platform for simulating power grid operation as a sequence of decisions. It lets an agent act on a grid over time, by changing generator setpoints, shedding load, carrying out maintenance or changing the grid topology to resolve security issues, and exposes this as a Gymnasium-compatible environment for sequential decision making. It is the library behind the Learning to Run a Power Network (L2RPN) competitions and is widely used in research, especially by the reinforcement learning community working on power systems. The platform is location-independent: it emulates the behaviour of a power grid of any size in any format, provided that a backend for that format is implemented. It is installed from PyPI (version 1.12.5, June 2026) or from source, including a Docker image, with documentation on read-the-docs, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at no cost. Caveats: a grid in a new format needs a backend to be written first, and the README keeps a section of tests and known issues that users should read. Simulation uses are network flow, operational resilience, optimisation of control strategies and digital-twin style testing of decision agents. Related records: no catalogued record is linked yet; its competition environments are catalogued separately when found.
